title: Measurement inspection exits with its output hidden
root_cause: The inspection command's output is discarded and its input is masked, leaving only a nonzero exit. The available evidence cannot distinguish malformed input from a rejected measurement or another runtime failure.

relevant_evidence.why: The step ends with a generic exit code and no command diagnostic.
The inspection output is redirected and its input comes from a secret.
The script can exit on different input conditions.
